selection_rule: Selected IRI_mean_y only after verifying it is present in the approved target_candidates.csv artifact.

selected_candidate_record.leakage_guard: Potential condition metric. Downstream agents must prevent leakage by excluding any post-period / outcome / future condition columns from features if applicable.

prediction_framing: Supervised regression target representing future or outcome pavement roughness condition. Higher IRI indicates rougher/worse pavement condition.
leakage_controls_for_future_states: Exclude IRI_mean_y from all predictor matrices.
Exclude any outcome-period or post-baseline variables not available at prediction time.
Treat IRI_mean_x as a baseline predictor only if temporally prior to IRI_mean_y.
Review Treatment_type before modeling because it may encode maintenance response or post-baseline intervention.
Review Future_AADT_mean_x before modeling because future/forecast traffic may be leakage if unavailable at prediction time.
notes: No modeling, EDA expansion, or feature engineering was performed in TARGET_SELECT.
Stale model metric memory records were retrieved only for traceability and not used.
